sentences.text: Shri Sankalp Sharma, learned counsel for applicant.
Shri R.S. Kushwah, learned Dy. Advocate General for res Investigating Officer Shri Sanjay Bhalavi and Shri Dharmendra Sharma, Sub-inspector, Cyber Crime are present in person.
T he applicant has filed this second application under Section 439 of C o d e o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail.

Applicant was arrested on 13.10.2022 by Police Station Crime Branch, District Gwalior in relation to Crime No.53/2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 120-B of IPC and Section 66C and 66D of IT Act.

entities.text: Police Station Crime Branch, District Gwalior
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per submissions of parties and the contents of case diary, it appears that case has wider ramifications because on the basis of forged Adhar Cards, SIMs have been purchased in bulk by different people and money has been routed out through different accounts.

At this stage, Shri Vinit Saxena, learned counsel appeared in the case for complainant submitted that he has filed a petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
for constitution of Special Investigation Team (SIT) because matter has serious connotations.
It may have the trappings of anti-national activities besides commission of crime.

List this case along with MCRC No. 42102 of 2023, which is a petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
at the instance of complainant, on 26.09.2023.
Meanwhile, I.G. Gwalior Zone and S.P. Gwalior are directed to look into the matter and come out with suggestions on next date of hearing.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE Vishal Manohar Rai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89229786/
